+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["shift", "update"])
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_reschedule_after_timeout(method: str) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
+        async with timeout(0) as cm:
+            await asyncio.sleep(10)
+
+    assert cm.expired
+    deadline = cm.deadline
+    with pytest.raises(
+        RuntimeError,
+        match=(
+            "(cannot reschedule expired timeout)|"
+            "(Cannot change state of expired Timeout)"
+        ),
+    ):
+        if method == "shift":
+            cm.shift(1)
+        else:
+            cm.update(asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + 1)
+    assert cm.deadline == deadline
+    assert cm.expired
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("delay", [None, 1])
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_update_after_cm_exit(delay: Optional[float]) -> None:
+    async with timeout(delay) as cm:
+        await asyncio.sleep(0)
+
+    deadline = cm.deadline
+    with pytest.raises(
+        RuntimeError,
+        match=(
+            "(cannot reschedule after exit from context manager)|"
+            "(Cannot change state of finished Timeout)"
+        ),
+    ):
+        cm.update(asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + 1)
+    assert cm.deadline == deadline
+    assert not cm.expired
+
